messages:
Evan T: hi all, i'm Evan, just started today. following the observability onboarding but i'm blocked on Grafana + Datadog for the inference service. Grafana redirects me to SSO forever and Datadog log explorer gives 403. my okta email is evan.t@redwood.ai

devex-bot: welcome @Evan T! please post your email and the specific dashboards or projects you need access to. docs: https://internal.redwood/docs/observability-onboard. if it's urgent tag @Infra Ops. :wave:

Evan T: thanks  email above. need grafana read for folder "inference" and access toDatadog logs for inference-prod. also would like to view Sentry errors for inference-runtime if that's separate.

Nina S: hey @Evan T, congrats on joining! two quick checks: 1) try an incognito browser to avoid stale cookies, 2) confirm your Okta groups include redwood-observability. i can add grafana perms if needed.

Evan T: incognito still loops. Okta shows me in redwood-engineers and redwood-observability.

Infra Ops: seen this before: sometimes the Grafana ACL cache and SCIM provisioning are slightly out of sync after onboarding. i've queued a manual SCIM sync for evan.t@redwood.ai and bumped Grafana ACLs. should take 2-4 minutes.

Observability Bot: scheduled provisioning sync for evan.t@redwood.ai (job id: sync-2026-03-23-11). will report success/failure.

Evan T: grafana works now, can view the inference dashboards 389. Datadog still 403 when opening the log explorer.

Nina S: for Datadog, we usually need the read role mirrored in the identity service. can you run this curl to test the API from your laptop (replace token):

```
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -H "DD-API-KEY: <workspace-token>" "https://api.datadoghq.com/api/v1/logs-queries/list"
```

Evan T: returns 403. i don't have the workspace token; tried with the one from vault and got 403 still.

Infra Ops: i see the provisioning sync completed but datadog role assignment queued failed once due to an identity-service race. i've manually granted evan.t@redwood.ai the datadog-log-read role. try again in a minute.

Evan T: Datadog access works now, thanks! Sentry invite came through as well and i can see recent errors. really appreciate the quick turnaround.

Evan T: follow-up Q: who should i ping to propose adding p95/p99 to the latency charts and adjust alert thresholds? want to avoid creating noisy alerts.

Nina S: small visual tweaks are fine via a PR in repos/infrastructure/grafana-dashboards with the exported JSON. Alerts and threshold changes need approval from @infra-observability; post a brief rationale in #observability-dashboards and tag them. If you want, i can pair-review your PR.

Evan T: awesome, i'll draft a PR with p95/p99 and a short note about why p99 is useful for tail latency alerts. thanks everyone!

Infra Ops: closing the access loop: grafana (grafana-viewers), datadog (datadog-log-read), sentry (project-view) assigned. reach out if anything else pops up. :thumbsup:
